schema_note: This document follows the wave10 function-handoff.v1 field set and adds five keys the wave10 shape did not need: the two decompilation_defects_corrected and unresolved_questions lists that carry the corrected evidence, observed_body.instruction_count_source, ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 and implementation.boundary_test.
semantic_label: service key lookup: resolve one opaque wide key through the scenarios table and copy the stored span into the destination
declaration: OpaqueBool __thiscall service_005f9230(OpaqueService* self, OpaqueWord key, OpaqueWide* dst)

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x18
abi.return_contract: one when the scenarios table holds a span for the key, zero otherwise; the byte is the only written part of EAX

observed_body.instruction_count_source: a linear objdump of the byte extent below; no staging handoff covered this address
instruction_list: read the scenarios key constant 0xffffffff at the head of the table
walk the eight table words comparing each against the requested key
load the stored begin and end words and compute the byte span
store the begin word and the end word into the destination pair
return the low byte of EAX as the found flag
no helper and no data virtual address is called directly

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the opaque span fields at 0x104 through 0x174 and never dereferences a vtable
0x0057cb60 and 0x00423650 are dependency-only ports, so the span assign and the copy are unverified in this package
the scenario key constants 0x2b978c46, 0x2399be55, 0x438f6347, 0x24682294, 0x476a98c7, 0x3d97a8e4, 0x04f684a4 and 0x366a930d are undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reads the table default 0xffffffff as a length; the assembly compares the requested key against it, so it is the sentinel entry and the model keeps the compare
the eight byte span is a pointer difference, not a count, so the model stores the begin and the end words separately

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
